extDescription.message: Get a notification and/or sound when new mail arrives in your logged-in Gmail accounts.

popupNoAccounts.message: No accounts selected yet. Open settings to choose which logged-in Google accounts to watch.

optionsDetectedNone.message: No logged-in Google account found. Make sure you're signed in to Gmail in this browser.

optionsDetectError.message: Could not check for accounts. Try again.

optionsToggleNotifications.message: Show a popup notification for new mail

optionsToggleSound.message: Play a sound for new mail

optionsToggleBadge.message: Show unread count on the toolbar icon

optionsToggleCopyCode.message: Show a "Copy" button for login codes

optionsCopyCodeHint.message: Detects verification codes (e.g. from Twitch, GitHub, DHL) in the subject or preview of unread mail. Detection happens locally; nothing is sent anywhere.

optionsFooterHint.message: Checked out every 2 minutes. Uses your browser's existing Gmail login — no separate sign-in or password needed.
